machine.name: runnymede
machine.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 8 cores / 16 threads (SMT siblings N and N+8)
machine.cpufreq: amd_pstate active, governor performance, energy_performance_preference performance, boost on
machine.pinning: each benchmark process pinned to one core of its own with taskset (cores 2, 3, 4, 5; their SMT siblings 10-13 not used by the benchmark), four processes at a time
machine.shared_with: other measurement agents (excluded by a lock while these ran), the user's desktop session (idle) and occasional builds between measured passes

nixpkgs.source: the Sekka flake's root nixpkgs input

compilers.rust: rustc 1.99.0 (nixpkgs), release profile as Aizome's workspace: codegen-units 4, no LTO, debug = line-tables-only, baseline x86-64

hayro-fork.branch: aizome-perf (its tip on 2026-11-02); 50 commits on upstream 8558a8a5
hayro-fork.settings: hayro::render with InterpreterSettings::default(), RenderSettings::default(), one RenderCache per document

hayro-upstream.settings: as the fork's; upstream's RenderSettings::default() hints text and caches glyphs (added in #1705 and #1706 since the fork's base)

pdfium.build: from source with GN and GCC (is_clang=false), is_debug=false, pdf_enable_v8=false (no JavaScript, no XFA), PartitionAlloc off, AGG renderer (no Skia), system FreeType 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0, OpenJPEG 2.5.4, lcms2 2.19.1, libpng, libtiff, zlib, HarfBuzz, ICU 78.3
pdfium.api: its C API directly: FPDF_LoadDocument, a form-fill environment, FPDF_RenderPageBitmap with FPDF_ANNOT, then FPDF_FFLDraw

mupdf.api: C API: fz_load_page, a draw device into an RGB pixmap cleared to white, fz_run_page (contents, annotations and widgets); one thread

poppler-splash.api: poppler::page_renderer (Splash), antialiasing and text_antialiasing hints, ARGB32, white paper

poppler-cairo.api: poppler_page_render into a cairo RGB24 image surface painted white

pdfjs.package: npm pdfjs-dist 6.5.438 (legacy build) with @napi-rs/canvas 1.1.0 (Skia), on nixpkgs Node.js 24.21.0
pdfjs.api: getDocument, getPage, page.render into a canvas; pdf.js's fake worker in the same thread

corpus.source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js test/pdfs, the PDFs in the repository (not the linked ones)

conformance_sources.hayro_tests: tests/ of each hayro revision; PDFs and reference images downloaded from https://hayro-assets.dev on first run
conformance_sources.pdfium: https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium branch chromium/8110 at 7c55203ed66b0461378323e3fcf2efaf76755241 (testing/resources/pixel, testing/tools/fixup_pdf_template.py, testing/SUPPRESSIONS)
conformance_sources.chromium_test_fonts: chromium/src/third_party/test_fonts at 7f51783942943e965cd56facf786544ccfc07713 (PDFium's DEPS), test_fonts.tar.gz sha1 cd96fc55dc243f6c6f4cb63ad117cad6cd48dceb from the chromium-fonts bucket

power: /tmp/claude-1000/perf/bin/powermeter: the amdgpu hwmon PPT sensor (CPU cores, iGPU and SoC/IO die; not RAM, NVIDIA card or PSU), sampled every 10 ms
